description: An HTML file that structures a database viewer interface. It allows users to browse tables and data from connected databases, includes styles for layout and design, and contains JavaScript functionality for dynamic content loading.

classes.name: DatabaseViewer
classes.description: Main class that governs the database viewer functionality, handling database connections and user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and updates the displayed data.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables from the selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays the data for a specific table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data in a tabular format in the content area.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands a cell in the data table to show more content.
